items.headline: Molecule details Trilogy gas ETRM integration
items.summary: Following its July acquisition of Trilogy Energy Solutions, Molecule executives outlined plans to merge physical gas scheduling with financial ETRM into one AI-enabled platform for producers and midstream operators.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has extended roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders and signaled plans to scale this trade-finance activity significantly further.

items.headline: Supertanker shortage spikes crude freight costs
items.summary: A severe shortage of supertankers has pushed the cost of shipping crude from Houston to Asia to about $26 per barrel, per Intelligent Audit's shipper briefing.

items.headline: EMIR Phase II reconciliation reaches UK regime
items.summary: Phase II trade-repository reconciliation, already live under EU EMIR since April, is scheduled to begin under UK EMIR in September, adding 61 new fields including valuation data, per TRAction.
